Script:


Kroonstad is in trouble – all the water sources have this week dried up. But the town’s 120 000 residents require 35-million litres of water a day. On Carte Blanche three weeks ago, Municipal Spokesperson, Khojane Madiba said the drought was to blame.
Devi: This is not just as a result of the drought. You’ve had failing infrastructure issues, lack of maintenance for a long time?
Madiba: We have got infrastructure that is old.
The infrastructure may be old, but the Moqhaka Local Municipality’s existing dams have not been maintained and water from the three operational municipal boreholes is contaminated with E. coli bacteria. We went back this week Hydrogeologist Derek Whittfield says the water from the municipal boreholes has still not been purified.
Derek: “We’ve seen the last of the surface water has been pumped from the one dam into another and when that’s all finished, all we’ll be left with is ground water.”
We also found the town’s storage dam - Bloemhoek - had dried up completely.
Tharine: “Communication from the municipality is restricted to the minimum.”
Tharine Hurter, editor of Kroonstad’s local newspaper says the municipality failed to tell residents that 30 JoJo tanks distributed as part of their intervention - two of which were stolen - will provide the only drinking water until rains, predicted in 6 months time. Yet, Pieter Bredenkamp the Municipal Managers office administrator indicated the situation is under control.
Pieter: “There’s not no water, we still have water in the Barend Wessels Dam that we’re redistributing to the reservoirs. At normal usage that dam would last more or less 10 days, but the treatment plant is not generating at full capacity.”
We found 1 of the 4 pumps distributing to reservoirs was broken and the water in the Barend Wessels Dam was a mere 20cm deep.
For now, it’s left to civil organizations like Water Shortage South Africa to assist with donated water. BUT Kroonstad is not alone. Senekal, will run dry within the next two weeks and Vryheid in Kwazulu Natal already has no water.
